module.title: ITensor tensor-network library and algorithms
module.expensive_path: BLAS/LAPACK-backed tensor contractions and iterative MPS/MPO ground-state sweeps at nontrivial bond dimension
module.rationale: The repository is a cohesive C++ tensor-network library whose tensor, MPS/MPO, quantum-number and iterative-solver code share one build and one scientific I/O contract. A whole-codebase module preserves the upstream API and lets official unit tests, samples and tutorials define the fixed points without inventing a method-only boundary.
excluded: Documentation-only files and generated build products are not source or checks.
Optional HDF5 tests remain unmeasured until the dependency is explicitly enabled and shown to be required by an official workflow.
hazards: BLAS/LAPACK backend and thread count can change reduction order and floating-point output.
The current macOS host lacks usable C++ standard-library headers; native runtimes require Linux or a repaired toolchain.
The stable C++ v3 branch is older than the active Julia line; the pin and API line must remain explicit.
